messages:
pagerbot: INCIDENT alert - streaming response queue growth detected in eu-west-1. p90 latency for /v1/chat/stream at 950ms (baseline 120ms). error rate 3.4% (5m). Triggers: queue depth > 10k, worker backpressure. Escalation: paging SRE-oncall

morgan: oncall here, looking. paging charts + logs now. can someone post the current rollout/flags for streaming?

kevin: I see a sustained spike in connection backlog on mux-proxy-03 and 04. GPU-side KV cache evictions rising. suspect catastrophic prefix cache churn from long-running sessions.

emily: support-ops heads-up: we have 4 active enterprise sessions hitting streaming heavily (AcmeCorp sandbox). Possible customer impact on interactive agents.

morgan: thanks. initial mitigation plan: 1) throttle new streaming sessions at the edge (shape to 20rps), 2) temporarily disable push/streaming response frames for public-hosted tier in eu-west-1, falling back to non-streaming chunked/resume polling, 3) increase short-term quota for non-streaming text generation for affected customers. I'll coordinate.

ana-product: if we disable streaming, product wants to ensure function-call clients are unaffected. Can we keep tool-calling synchronous?

kevin: yes — we can flip only the SSE/frame push transport. The backend generation path remains the same. Tool calls will still return full response at completion.

morgan: executing toggle. Ops endpoint: POST https://ops.internal/api/feature-flags/toggle
Payload: {"feature":"streaming_frames","region":"eu-west-1","state":"off","expires":"2026-03-15T03:15:00Z"}
Runbook step: curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_KEY" -X POST ...

infra-bot: Running preflight: checking dependent rollouts, routing policies, canaries. No active canary block.

kevin: also adding edge rate limit rule: route=chat/stream, region=eu-west-1, limit=20rps, burst=50. Command: terraform apply -var 'region=eu-west-1' -target=module.edge_rate_limit

morgan: support-ops, please prepare customer comms for AcmeCorp + top-50 by request volume. Template: short note, workaround (non-streaming polling), ETA for re-eval in 30m.

support-ops: prepping message. will prioritize enterprise channels and CSMs.

morgan: toggle in 2...1... DONE. feature streaming_frames eu-west-1 = OFF (by morgan). infra-bot: confirmed config pushed to edge-proxies.

pagerbot: Automation: noted toggle event in incident log (id: INC-1759003333-T01).

kevin: initial metrics: connection backlog falling, mux-proxy CPU down 18%, retry/timeout errors down from 3.4% -> 1.1% within 45s. p90 latency for chat endpoints (non-streaming) up slightly from 120ms -> 200ms but stable.

emily: customers on streaming will see responses come as one payload at the end or via polling. Notifying AcmeCorp Slack channel now.

ana-product: good. product requests we enable a segmented rollout after stabilization: keep streaming off for hosted tier, allow dedicated customers with reserved capacity to keep streaming after opt-in.

morgan: noted. action items: - monitor 5m, 15m windows - collect example failing streams for postmortem - prepare rollback plan to re-enable with traffic shaping and prefix-caching fixes

kevin: collecting traces and KV cache metrics. command to dump problematic sessions: 
```
kubectl -n runtime exec -it session-aggregator -- /bin/sh -c "pgrep -f 'session-worker' | xargs -I{} ss -tinp | grep 'ESTAB'"
```
will attach logs to incident thread.

infra-bot: Metrics snapshot attached: grafana link https://grafana.internal/d/streaming/stack?orgId=1&from=now-15m&to=now

morgan: moving to incidents#pager-handoff. @kevin you'll drive technical remediation. @ana-product you'll own customer comms cadence. I'll stay on until we reach stable p95 latency <250ms and error rate <1%.

support-ops: sent templated messages to AcmeCorp & top 50 customers. Slack threads created. No major escalations yet, monitoring responses.

kevin: early root causes look like a mix of long-lived sessions + aggressive prefix invalidations from model-version swap earlier today. I'll stage a fix: limit prefix cache invalidation frequency + tune eviction policy.

morgan: ETA on partial fix?

kevin: config change queued, testing in canary now. If green, push in 10-15m.

pagerbot: Note: paging reminder in 30 minutes for check-in and state transition (mitigated -> monitoring).

morgan: agreed. re-enable plan: 1) re-enable streaming frames for dedicated/reserved tier first, 2) enable for hosted gradually with rate limit 10rps per client and KV prewarm + sticky routing, 3) watch for queue growth for 20m windows.

emily: logging note — add ephemeral header X-Stream-Fallback: true to responses so clients can detect fallback and surface UX hints.

morgan: good idea. implementing now.

infra-bot: Incident status: mitigation applied (streaming disabled in eu-west-1), impact: medium (interactive degrading to polling for some customers), assigned: kevin (tech), ana-product (customer comms), morgan (oncall). Next check-in 30m.

kevin: will attach PR for cache tuning and a short test report within the thread before the 30m checkin.

support-ops: if any customer demands SLA credits, escalate to ops-rev. Keep me looped.

morgan: thanks team. keep messages short here and use the incident thread for artifacts. I'll update status in 30m or sooner if situation changes. :thumbsup:

pagerbot: Reminder: 30m check-in scheduled at 1759005133.

morgan: (follow-up 12m later) metrics look stable. p95 chat <220ms, error rate 0.9%. prepping scoped re-enable for dedicated tier now.

kevin: canary enabling streaming_frames for dedicated-eu-west-1 = ON (canary group 5% traffic). monitoring for 5m.

infra-bot: Canary healthy after 5m. No regressions.

morgan: expanding to 25% dedicated, rolling slowly.

emily: support update: customers acknowledge workaround. no new priority tickets.

morgan: moving incident to MONITORING. owners will remain until full re-enable for hosted. postmortem will include action items: better cache prewarming, safer model-version swap gating, and automated fallback header for clients.

kevin: attaching logs and PR links now.

support-ops: closing customer comms loop for now. will await final update before sending closure messages.

morgan: incident closed->monitoring at 1759003933. thanks everyone.
